NodeId.description:
Type-safe identifier for a node in a financial model.

Serializes as a plain string and is interoperable with `&str` via
[`Borrow`] and [`AsRef`].

PeriodScope.description: Scope that determines which periods a check applies to.

oneOf.description: Run the check on every period.

description: Flags line items whose period-over-period growth exceeds configurable upper / lower bounds.

max_decline_pct.description: Maximum negative growth rate as a decimal (e.g. −0.30 = −30 %).

max_period_growth_pct.description: Maximum positive growth rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.50 = 50 %).

nodes.description: Nodes to monitor for growth-rate plausibility.

title: GrowthRateConsistency
